admission_requirements.general_requirements: Admission to residency and higher specialization programs at JUH requires a medical/dental degree with minimum grade of Good, valid practice license, Tawjihi certificate, and passing a written exam and personal interview; English proficiency required (TOEFL iBT 90, IELTS 6.5, or OET C); patient admission for medical services based on urgency, specialty availability, and bed availability
admission_requirements.exam_details: Written exam and personal interview required for higher specialization (residency) programs in medicine and dentistry
admission_requirements.english_requirement: TOEFL iBT minimum 90 or IELTS minimum 6.5 or OET grade C for higher specialization programs

tuition_fees.notes: Higher specialization (residency) program fees for Jordanians: 1,066 JOD annual university fees including academic year fee (960 JOD), insurance (56 JOD), computer usage (40 JOD), and service charges (10 JOD per semester); one-time fees: 20 JOD application fee, 150 JOD admission fee. Fees for non-Jordanian students vary.

ranking_accreditation.accreditation: Joint Commission International (JCI), Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP), ISO; affiliated with University of Jordan and King Hussein Cancer Center
ranking_accreditation.international_recognition: First hospital in Arab region and second in Middle East to receive JCI accreditation; first university teaching hospital in Jordan and one of the first in the Arab world; described as 'the first academic medical center at the level of the Arab world'

market_demand.notes: JUH is the premier teaching hospital in Jordan and a major referral center, serving approximately half a million patients annually. Medical graduates from JUH achieve top scores in US medical specialization exams. High demand for healthcare professionals in Jordan and the region.

campus_facilities.accommodation_details: As a teaching hospital located within the University of Jordan campus, patients and students may access University of Jordan dormitories; JUH itself does not operate dedicated patient accommodation
campus_facilities.scholarship_details: Scholarships may be available through the University of Jordan for students training at JUH; no independent JUH scholarship programs identified
